title: Integral equations for a smooth presentation after rescaling the extra variables
statement: Let $R$ and $\Lambda$ be commutative rings, $\Lambda$ an $R$-algebra, $S\subseteq R$ a multiplicative submonoid, $K=S^{-1}R$ and $L=S^{-1}\Lambda$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. Let $n,m,c\in\mathbf N$ with $c\le n+m$, let $D$ be a $K$-algebra, and let $Q$ be a submersive presentation of $D$ with generators indexed by $\operatorname{Fin}(n+m)$, relations indexed by $\operatorname{Fin}(c)$, and selected variables the first $c$ [def-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-algebra]. Let $\gamma:D\to L$ be a $K$-algebra homomorphism. Suppose $l^{\rm first}:\operatorname{Fin}(n)\to\Lambda$ satisfies $\gamma(Q.\mathrm{val}_i)=l^{\rm first}_i/1$ for the first $n$ generators. Then there exist polynomials $f_j\in R[X_0,\ldots,X_{n+m-1}]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], elements $l_i\in\Lambda$ and $z_i\in D$ such that $l_i=l^{\rm first}_i$ and $z_i=Q.\mathrm{val}_i$ for $i<n$, $\gamma(z_i)=l_i/1$ for all $i$, evaluation $K[X]\to D$ at $z$ is surjective, its kernel is the ideal generated by the coefficient extensions of the $f_j$, and evaluation at $z$ of the coefficient extension of $\det(\partial f_j/\partial X_i)_{i,j<c}$ is a unit [def-weil-pbc-polynomial-partial-derivative].

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Tag 07F4 (lemma-delocalize-base), proof: rescaling the extra variables and clearing the coefficients of the equations; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07F4

proof.text: Write the image of each extra generator as l_i/d_i in the localization of Lambda, with d_i in S; for the first n generators take d_i=1 and l_i=lfirst_i. This is IsLocalization.surj, with the denominator pulled back along R to Lambda. Form z_i=(d_i/1)Q.val_i. The factorization condition on the first n images gives the prescribed l_i there, and gamma(z_i)=l_i/1 for every i. Empty extra families need no choices.

Construct the polynomial automorphism tau by X_i mapped to (d_i/1) inverse times X_i. Its inverse multiplies X_i by d_i/1. Evaluation at z composed with tau is evaluation at the original generators, as checked on constants and variables. Surjectivity follows from the original presentation. Transport its kernel through tau, using map-comap for a surjective ring map and the original relation-span equality. The new equations are q_j=tau(Q.relation_j).

The polynomial ring over the localized coefficient ring is the localization at constant denominators (Mathlib MvPolynomial.isLocalization, proved by polynomial scalar extension and localization base change). For each q_j choose f_j and drel_j in S with map(f_j)=C(drel_j/1)q_j using IsLocalization.surj. Each constant multiplier is a unit, so the spans of the mapped f_j and q_j agree, by Ideal.span_range_eq_iSup and span_singleton_mul_left_unit. This gives the asserted kernel.

Prove the diagonal-substitution chain rule by induction on polynomials: differentiation of tau(p) in variable i equals C((d_i/1) inverse)tau(partial_i p). Differentiate the equation map(f_j)=C(drel_j/1)q_j; partial derivatives commute with the coefficient map. Evaluate at z and use the evaluation-composition identity. The resulting Jacobian matrix is the original evaluated Jacobian with selected rows multiplied by (d_i/1) inverse and columns multiplied by drel_j/1. Matrix.det_mul_row and det_mul_column express its determinant as the original unit determinant times two finite products of units. Thus it is a unit, also for c=0. No localization map is assumed injective.

lean.statement: theorem exists_rescaled_integral_presentation {R : Type u} {Λ : Type w} [CommRing R] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra R Λ] (S : Submonoid R) {n m c : ℕ} (hc : c ≤ n + m) {D : Type x} [CommRing D] [Algebra (Localization S) D] (Q : SubmersivePresentation (Localization S) D (Fin (n + m)) (Fin c)) (γ : D →ₐ[Localization S] Localization (algebraMapSubmonoid Λ S)) (lfirst : Fin n → Λ) (hmap : Q.map = Fin.castLE hc) (hfirst : ∀ i : Fin n, γ (Q.val (Fin.castAdd m i)) = algebraMap Λ (Localization (algebraMapSubmonoid Λ S)) (lfirst i)) : ∃ (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin (n + m)) R) (l : Fin (n + m) → Λ) (z : Fin (n + m) → D), (∀ i : Fin n, l (Fin.castAdd m i) = lfirst i) ∧ (∀ i : Fin n, z (Fin.castAdd m i) = Q.val (Fin.castAdd m i)) ∧ (∀ i, γ (z i) = algebraMap Λ (Localization (algebraMapSubmonoid Λ S)) (l i)) ∧ Function.Surjective (aeval z : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + m)) (Localization S) →ₐ[_] D) ∧ RingHom.ker (aeval z : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + m)) (Localization S) →ₐ[_] D) = Ideal.span (Set.range (fun j ↦ MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization S)) (f j))) ∧ IsUnit (aeval z (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization S)) (Matrix.det (fun i j : Fin c ↦ pderiv (Fin.castLE hc i) (f j)))))
